notes.title: Thank you for all the support.
notes.notes: We want to thank each and everyone for playing our game, we really appreciate it. We noticed that a few of you had encountered an error with the Smash Achievement that has been fixed along with the bug that you encountered in the last level. We pushed the update last night. We are really sorry about the delay, our team has been working super hard to get our new game The Last Train done.  [url=thelasttrain.net]Website[/url]

notes.title: The 1.2.0 Update is out with the Tranquiliser fix.
notes.notes:
We just pushed the new update out! The issue with the tranquliser has been fixed. Thanks a lot for the feedback and your continued support.


Our team is working hard on version 1.3.0 which will have the level editor and steam workshop integration. If you guys have more suggestion then please let us know.

notes.title: About the Tranqulizer Issue
notes.notes:
Hi we've just heard back from a few of you that the Tranquilizer isn't working. We should have explained it better.

Temporary Fix:

Just click on the tranquilizer and choose any direction you want to shoot.

We are working on an update which will teach the player this mechanic. Sorry for the inconvenience caused. If you have any other please let us know we will get to work to fix it right away.

Plans for the future:

We are currently fixing the tranq issue and we are working on an awesome level editor which would allow everyone to create levels in the game. We are looking to launch it earlier next year!

notes.title: The Ultimate Heist is finally out :)
notes.notes:
The Ultimate Heist is now finally out for everyone to play, we have done our best to make the Steam version of the game to be the definitive version. This version features new levels, new art and special cut scenes.

We are working hard to add more meaningful content to the game. More specifically a full fledged level editor which will allow you to create your own levels and share it with your community! We can't wait to get it to your hands, we would really appreciate any feedback for the game.
